description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that manages a LogView and provides functionality to display logs in a scrollable view within an Android app. It includes UI setup for log display and handles text change events to scroll to the latest log entries.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a LogView for displaying log messages and manages scrolling behavior when log content changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, configuring their layout parameters, appearance, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy by calling inflateViews() and attaches a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when log text updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by the fragment.
